title: Read-only release probe for the seven registry pages
hosted_verification_note: No VM or SSH access of any kind and no operator key read. Functional evidence only (local fixture HTTP server with recorded hosted ids and the real handler envelopes). Hosted verification belongs to the operator acceptance task.
operator_approval: 2026-11-25, conversation 52a1dacf (照建議 全部處理好), names the seven registry pages; the feature freeze does not apply to this scope.

acceptance.ac1_probe_contract: acceptance/probes/mgmt-registry-pages-readable: viewer login via /bff/auth/dev-login, GET only (the fixture server fails the test if any other method or a second POST arrives), exit 0 passed / 1 failed / 77 skipped naming the missing variable; failed checks print 'FAILED <check> owner=<task> code=<code> route=<route> values=<json>'; the token and secret are asserted absent from stdout in every test, including a failed login.

ac2_failures.strategy_state_totals: state_total_differs_from_visible_state_counts (total vs meta.visible_state_counts for no filter, state=draft, state=retired); visible_state_counts_missing when null
ac2_failures.strategy_metrics_vs_pulse: list_metric_differs_from_trading_pulse (pnl/totalTrades of a running strategy vs its single runtime_rows entry, one re-read of both); fresh_metrics_with_null_values_without_reason
ac2_failures.lineage_node_names: lineage_node_without_name for a running strategy root (display_name empty or name_missing not false); lineage_unavailable_or_empty
ac2_failures.evidence_detail_paging: evidence_detail_is_list_shaped; deep_page_empty_with_surface_ok (offset total-1 empty while meta.surfaces.evidence_refs is ok)
ac2_failures.cited_sources_visible: cited_list_hides_failed_source (non-ok source missing from summary.sources_not_ok, incomplete not true or surface ok); cited_source_not_reported
ac2_failures.postmortem_infra_hidden: infrastructure_draft_in_default_list (owner is_infrastructure_postmortem rule on PostmortemResponse fields, asserted equal to services.incident.incident on four rows); hidden_infrastructure_count_missing

acceptance.ac3_denied_and_owners: A 401/403 on a check's route is reported as 'DENIED <check> ...' with status denied and does not fail that check (test_viewer_role_denial_is_denied_not_failed, lineage is operator-only). Every check result carries its owner task id (OWNERS map, asserted equal to the check list).
acceptance.ac4_tests_readme: acceptance/test_mgmt_registry_pages_readable.py: 27 tests, one passing world plus 15 failing cases (at least one per check) each run through a local HTTP fixture server and asserting exactly that one check fails; route registration test checks all 8 requested routes are GET routes of the real BFF app. acceptance/README.md lists the probe. The state=draft duration is printed as 'INFO ... (information only)'; test_draft_duration_is_information_only feeds a 3600 s read and the result still passes.
acceptance.stage_test: scripts/test_dev_acceptance_stage.py: the expected discovered probe list gains probe:mgmt-registry-pages-readable (it skips with exit 77 without viewer credentials like its siblings).

justified_changed_assertions: scripts/test_dev_acceptance_stage.py test_replay_root_44247825979_daily_probe_failure_does_not_fail_release: the exact probe id list gains one new entry, probe:mgmt-registry-pages-readable. Nothing weakened or removed; a new probe directory necessarily changes that list.
tests_run: .venv-pantheon/bin/python3 -m pytest -q scripts/test_dev_acceptance_stage.py acceptance/ -> 300 passed (before the one added route test)
residual_findings: Strategy rows do not expose the runtime binding id, so the metric comparison joins list rows to Trading Pulse by strategy_id and skips (does not fail) a strategy that has more than one pulse row; hosted multi-binding strategies are therefore not compared.

Strategy default pages are read with exclude_state=draft (at most 10 pages of 200) for metrics and live-strategy discovery; state=draft is only counted with page_size=1 so the draft read time stays the single owner call that the task wants printed.
BFF-EVO-JOURNAL-POOL-VERSIONS-20261125 is a declared prerequisite but its page already has acceptance/probes/mgmt-evolution-pages-readable; it is not duplicated here.

reopen_20261125.defect_1_artifacts_page_size: ARTIFACTS was /bff/artifacts?page_size=200 read as one page; research/routes/artifacts.py enforces Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100), so hosted BFF b3f93d448 answered HTTP 422 and persona_artifact_scope failed read_failed http_422. Now page_size=100 and _all_pages follows next_page_token (test_artifacts_follow_next_page_token_and_fail_on_a_later_page).
reopen_20261125.fixture_bounds: The fixture server answers HTTP 422 for out-of-range queries using the real bounds: artifacts page_size 1..100, strategies 1..200, personas 1..200, evidence 1..100 (list and cited), postmortems 1..200, lineage depth 1..20 (test_fixture_server_enforces_real_route_bounds, test_every_probe_request_is_inside_the_real_route_bounds, test_artifacts_page_size_above_route_bound_would_fail_read).
reopen_20261125.defect_2_default_view: New check strategy_default_view_counts reads /bff/strategies?exclude_state=draft&hide_retired_personas=true&page_size=1: visible_state_counts null -> default_view_visible_state_counts_missing; differs from the unfiltered view -> default_view_counts_differ_from_unfiltered_view; total != non-draft non-retired visible counts minus hidden_retired_persona_count -> default_view_total_differs_from_visible_state_counts (hosted shape 14-11=3 passes). Failures print owner=BFF-STRATEGY-DEFAULT-VIEW-COUNTS-20261125 (per-failure owner override; the check default owner is REGISTRY-STRATEGY-LIST-OWNER-HIDE-20261125).
justified_changed_assertions: test_unreadable_route_fails_that_check_only: expected route string page_size=200 -> page_size=100, because the probe's artifacts route changed to the real bound; same assertion otherwise (read_failed, http_404).
